about: A literal compared with a .title is one of the format's titles (chapter 3 § 3.4.1). The input specialty is a labelled enum titled Medical oncology and Radiation oncology. Invalid: the agent node plan's if compares its title with "Surgery". Valid: with "Medical oncology".
sentences: Node 'plan' compares input.specialty.title with "Surgery", which is not one of its titles (Medical oncology, Radiation oncology).
